blocks.source: assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'returned', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 500), (2, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 300), (3, 2, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 150), (4, 2, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 60) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(2, 2, '210.00')], 'returned rows filtered before counting'

assert rows_on(q, **{'employees': "SELECT CAST(emp_id AS INT) AS emp_id, CAST(name AS STRING) AS name, CAST(dept AS STRING) AS dept, CAST(manager_id AS INT) AS manager_id, CAST(salary AS INT) AS salary, CAST(hire_date AS DATE) AS hire_date FROM VALUES (1, 'a', 'X', NULL, 100, DATE'2020-01-01'), (2, 'b', 'X', NULL, 200, DATE'2020-01-01') AS employees(emp_id, name, dept, manager_id, salary, hire_date)"}) == [('X', 150.0, 150.0)], 'even count interpolates'

assert rows_on(q, **{'events': "SELECT CAST(user_id AS INT) AS user_id, CAST(event AS STRING) AS event, CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM VALUES (1, 'view', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 09:00:00'), (1, 'view', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 10:00:00'), (2, 'view', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 09:00:00'), (2, 'purchase', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-02 09:00:00') AS events(user_id, event, ts)"}) == [], 'repeat views do not count'
